_example: EXAMPLE ONLY. A made-up niche (home espresso) to show the format. Copy this file to config.json in your work folder and replace every value with your own niche.
niche: Home espresso and latte art for beginners
keep_rule: Keep only videos that teach or show making espresso drinks at home: technique, latte art, gear for home baristas, routines. Out: cafe vlogs with no coffee making, unrelated cooking, music, news, generic product unboxings with no brewing.

clusters.technique: Pulling shots, dialing in, grind and ratio
clusters.other: Anything kept that fits none of the above
